identity.fantasy: A familiar marksman who uses Quick Shot to gain Advantage, empowers Precision Shot, and layers quivers, bleeds, and piercing finishers.
identity.one_line: Build Advantage with Quick Shot, empower Precision Shot, then choose Deadshot, Brutal Shot or late Incendiary payoff.

mechanics.core_loop: A marksman using Quick Shot and Advantage to empower Precision Shot, bleeds, poisons, quivers, and large piercing finishers. It can skirmish at range and build toward Deadshot or Brutal Shot windows; the loop is familiar to Hunter players and comparatively readable.

modes.name: Precision Shot
modes.structural_description: Precisely shoot an enemy from a great distance, inflicting 38 + 48.5% ranged AP Physical damage.Damage increased for each stack of Advantage.Usable while in Elude.

mechanics.single_target: On durable targets, the structural path grows from Precision Shot, Skirmisher, Devastating Shots toward One Shot, One Kill, Silent, But Deadly, Brutal Shot. A precise priority remains limited to the captured build and community evidence.
mechanics.aoe: For multiple targets, Build Advantage with Quick Shot, empower Precision Shot, then choose Deadshot, Brutal Shot or late Incendiary payoff. The current evidence particularly constrains this through: Levelers report weak questing, limited AoE, low mobility and scarce self-healing before that point.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged skirmishing is supported, although its larger aimed finishers still reward planned positioning.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Deadshot, Corrosive Poison, Opportunist, Silent, But Deadly, Brutal Shot.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Boots of Elvenkind, Neurotoxin Arrow, Bleeding Edge, Brutal Shot.
